books.title: Advanced Visual Basic 6: Power Techniques for Everyday Programs
books.author: Matthew Curland
books.summary: The ultimate authority on the internal plumbing of VB6. Details how the VB6 runtime represents memory, object references, virtual method tables (vtables), array descriptors (SAFEARRAY), strings (BSTR), and thread apartments.

relevance.compiler_x64: Blueprint for implementing COM vtable layout, direct interface implementation without dual interface overhead, function pointers via AddressOf, and ASM call thunks.
relevance.runtime_x64: Crucial details for reimplementing SAFEARRAY descriptors, BSTR length-prefixed strings, Variant memory layouts, weak reference management, and memory manipulation (VarPtr, StrPtr, ObjPtr).
relevance.ide_x64: Understanding type library generation, interface introspection, early vs late binding mechanics.
relevance.win32_api_x64: Window subclassing, hooking, function pointer dispatch, and thunks.

chapters.title: VB Objects and the Running Object Table

books.title: Hardcore Visual Basic
books.author: Bruce McKinney
books.summary: Classic practical guide to low-level Windows programming in Visual Basic. Unveils the C-like power hidden behind Basic: pointers, memory copies, subclassing, Windows API, and COM type libraries.

relevance.compiler_x64: Shows exact behavior of AddressOf, callback signatures, type aliasing in Declare, and type coercion rules.
relevance.runtime_x64: Detailed behavior of BSTR strings, byte arrays, ANSI-to-Unicode conversion layers in Declare calls, error raising and Win32 error translation.
relevance.ide_x64: Techniques for project structuring, resource management, and debugging tools.
relevance.win32_api_x64: HWND handling, Windows messaging architecture, subclassing traps, memory handles (HGLOBAL, GDI).

chapters.title: Error Handling and Debugging
topics: Translating Win32 Errors to VB Errors

books.title: Programming Microsoft Visual Basic 6.0
books.author: Francesco Balena
books.summary: The definitive, comprehensive reference for VB6 syntax, controls, events, and runtime functions. Defines the baseline expected language behavior for the compiler, form designer, and runtime.

relevance.compiler_x64: Serves as the golden specification for AST parsing, statement semantics, operator precedence, scoping, variable declaration, arrays, and classes.
relevance.runtime_x64: Full functional specification for VBA runtime modules: Strings (Mid, InStr, Replace), Conversion (CStr, CLng, Val), Math, DateTime, FileSystem, ErrObject, and Collection.
relevance.ide_x64: Complete blueprint for form files (.frm), control properties, events, menus, toolbars, user controls, and data binding.
relevance.win32_api_x64: Includes comprehensive Appendix of Win32 API functions adapted to VB6.

chapters.title: The Visual Basic for Applications Library
topics: Strings, Conversion, Math, DateTime, FileSystem, Interaction, Information

books.title: Visual Basic Programmer's Guide to the Win32 API
books.author: Daniel Appleman
books.summary: The monumental guide to calling the Windows Win32 API from Visual Basic. Details parameter passing conventions, memory layouts, pointers, handles, structures, callbacks, and Windows messages.

relevance.compiler_x64: Crucial for designing 64-bit Declare syntax, LongPtr / LongLong types, ByVal/ByRef marshaling, struct padding/alignment, and callback calling conventions.
relevance.runtime_x64: Memory allocation APIs (GlobalAlloc, LocalAlloc, HeapAlloc), ANSI/Unicode BSTR marshaling, and translating API errors.
relevance.ide_x64: API declaration text viewer and validator.
relevance.win32_api_x64: Complete reference for HWND, HDC, HBITMAP handles, GDI drawing, Windows messaging, and process/thread management.

chapters.title: List Box, Combo Box, and Button Messages

books.title: Developing COM/ActiveX Components with Visual Basic 6: A Guide to the Perplexed
books.author: Dan Appleman
books.summary: Deep exploration of how VB6 creates, compiles, and hosts COM components: ActiveX DLLs, ActiveX EXEs, ActiveX Controls (OCX), and ActiveX Documents.

relevance.compiler_x64: Rules for generating COM interfaces, IDispatch implementations, connection points (IConnectionPointContainer), and binary compatibility verification.
relevance.runtime_x64: Component activation, ClassFactory stubs, threading models (Single, Apartment, Multi-threaded), and object persistence (PropertyBag).
relevance.ide_x64: UserControl designer, Ambient and Extender properties, Property Pages, and ActiveX control hosting.
relevance.win32_api_x64: In-process DLL loading vs Out-of-process EXE marshaling.

books.title: Essential COM
books.author: Don Box
books.summary: The definitive theoretical guide to the Component Object Model. Explains COM at the binary and ABI level: vtables, IUnknown, QueryInterface identity rules, IClassFactory, Apartments, and Marshaling.

relevance.compiler_x64: Authoritative reference for COM ABI in x64 Windows (64-bit vtables, 64-bit pointer offsets, calling conventions).
relevance.runtime_x64: Reimplementing IUnknown, IDispatch, IClassFactory, IEnumVARIANT, IMalloc, and IErrorInfo from scratch in 64 bits.
relevance.ide_x64: Understanding type library generation and COM registration.

books.title: Professional VB6 Business Objects & Distributed Objects Codebase

books.summary: Complete source code collection (418 files, 197 classes) from Rockford Lhotka's landmark books on N-Tier object-oriented architecture in VB6. Precursor to the CSLA framework.

relevance.win32_api_x64: Distributed DCOM / MTS transactional state transfer.

relevance.runtime_x64: Detailed behavior of all standard functions, enums, constants, and error conditions.

vtable_and_com_abi.title: Virtual Method Tables (VTables) & COM ABI
vtable_and_com_abi.description: How VB6 and COM represent objects in memory, table of pointers to functions, IUnknown base (QueryInterface, AddRef, Release), and 64-bit alignment.

references.notes: VB's internal IUnknown, calling vtable functions directly
VTable-binding custom control interfaces
Creating lightweight COM objects with custom raw vtables
VTable patching and method interception
Abstract base classes as binary interfaces & vtables
IUnknown implementation, vtable layout, QueryInterface
COM behind the curtain, vtable inspection

vtable_and_com_abi.compiler_relevance: Emit 64-bit pointer vtables for Class modules and Implements interfaces. Offset 0=QI, Offset 8=AddRef, Offset 16=Release, Offset 24+ = Custom methods (or IDispatch for dual).
vtable_and_com_abi.runtime_relevance: Object headers must point to the vtable pointer. Implement IUnknown and IDispatch vtable stubs.

safearray_memory_descriptors.title: Array Descriptors & SAFEARRAY Memory Layout
safearray_memory_descriptors.description: The exact internal memory structure of VB6 arrays: SAFEARRAY structure, SAFEARRAYBOUND, cDims, cbElements, pvData, and bounds checking.

references.notes: Complete breakdown of SAFEARRAY descriptor, reading/writing array variables, wrapping raw C pointers in SAFEARRAY without copying
Using VarPtrArray and living pointers to array headers
Dynamic arrays, ReDim Preserve behavior, Erase rules
Passing arrays to Win32 DLLs, array pointers

safearray_memory_descriptors.compiler_relevance: Array indexing syntax array(i, j) calculation based on SAFEARRAY bounds. Generating calls to SafeArrayGetElement / SafeArrayAccessData or raw pointer arithmetic.
safearray_memory_descriptors.runtime_relevance: In 64 bits: cbElements and pvData are 64-bit aligned. SafeArrayCreate, SafeArrayDestroy, SafeArrayRedim implementation.

bstr_unicode_strings.title: BSTR Strings & Unicode/ANSI Bridging
bstr_unicode_strings.description: BSTR memory model: 4-byte length prefix before the string pointer, UTF-16 wchar_t data, null-terminated. Handling automatic ANSI conversion in Win32 Declare statements.

references.notes: Strings in VB: BSTR internals, SysAllocString, SysFreeString, StrPtr vs VarPtr
Deep dive into VB string memory, Unicode vs ANSI bridging, byte arrays (StrConv)
How VB converts strings to ANSI during API calls, LPSTR vs LPWSTR
VBA String functions: Left, Right, Mid, InStr, Replace, StrConv

bstr_unicode_strings.compiler_relevance: Distinguish between Declare Function ... (ByVal s As String) [auto ANSI] and modern x64 Unicode declarations. StrPtr returns pointer to raw UTF-16 data.
bstr_unicode_strings.runtime_relevance: Fast UTF-16 string engine, SysAllocStringByteLen, SysAllocStringLen, SysFreeString, BSTR concatenation with pre-allocated buffer.

variant_and_type_coercion.title: VARIANT & VARIANTARG Memory Layout
variant_and_type_coercion.description: 16-byte union in 32-bit (24-byte in 64-bit due to 8-byte alignment): VARTYPE vt, wReserved1-3, data union (llVal, lVal, bstrVal, pdispVal, punkVal, parray, etc.).

references.notes: Variant internals, living pointers into Variants, VarPtr on Variants
IDispatch, VARIANT types, DISPPARAMS marshaling
Variant overhead, internal subtypes, VariantCopyInd
Variant type coercion rules, IsMissing, Empty vs Null

variant_and_type_coercion.compiler_relevance: 64-bit VARIANT size is 24 bytes (alignment padding). Subtyping rules, implicit Variant conversion.
variant_and_type_coercion.runtime_relevance: VariantInit, VariantClear, VariantCopy, VariantChangeType routines in 64 bits.

win32_api_64bit_migration.title: Win32 API Declarations & 64-Bit Migration (LongPtr & LongLong)
win32_api_64bit_migration.description: Porting Declare statements from 32-bit to 64-bit: replacing 32-bit Long with LongPtr for handles (HWND, HDC, HINSTANCE) and pointers; LongLong for 64-bit integers; struct alignment.

references.notes: Visual Basic-Windows Interface: Declare, ByVal/ByRef, Types, Any, Callbacks
Translating C headers (.h) to VB, struct packing rules
GetWindowLong/SetWindowLong -> Must use GetWindowLongPtr/SetWindowLongPtr in x64
Memory, structures, CopyMemory, structure alignment in 64 bits

win32_api_64bit_migration.compiler_relevance: Introduce LongPtr keyword (resolves to 64-bit integer on x64, 32-bit on x86). Introduce LongLong keyword (^ suffix). Adjust UDT struct padding to 8-byte boundaries.
win32_api_64bit_migration.runtime_relevance: Foreign Function Interface (FFI) call generator using x64 Windows calling convention (RCX, RDX, R8, R9 + stack shadow space of 32 bytes).

subclassing_and_wndproc.title: Safe Window Subclassing, Hooking & CallWindowProc
subclassing_and_wndproc.description: Intercepting Windows messages (WM_*) for VB forms and controls without IDE crashes. Machine-code thunks vs SetWindowLongPtr.

references.notes: Calling function pointers, CallWindowProc hack, ASM thunks
Overriding functions, safe subclassing
Receiving messages, encapsulating message traps
Window lifecycle messages, message queues

subclassing_and_wndproc.compiler_relevance: AddressOf operator returning function pointers that adhere to the x64 Windows ABI for callback procedures.
subclassing_and_wndproc.runtime_relevance: Integration with SetWindowSubclass (comctl32.dll) for safe, crash-free subclassing.

error_handling_errobject.title: ErrObject, On Error, and HRESULT Exception Handling
error_handling_errobject.description: How VB6 traps runtime errors and HRESULTs from COM calls. ErrObject interface (_ErrObject), Number, Source, Description, Raise, Clear.

references.notes: On Error GoTo, On Error Resume Next, Err object methods
How VB6 converts failing HRESULTs to Err.Raise
When and how to raise errors, Win32 error translation
ISupportErrorInfo, IErrorInfo, ICreateErrorInfo

error_handling_errobject.compiler_relevance: Implement On Error GoTo / Resume Next jump tables and exception handlers in generated code.
error_handling_errobject.runtime_relevance: Implement ErrObject coclass with GUID {a4c46654-499f-101b-bb78-00aa00383cbb} and exact dispids: Number(0), Source(0x60020002), Description(0x60020004), Raise(0x6002000a), Clear(0x6002000b).

collections_and_for_each.title: Collection Object & For Each Enumeration (_NewEnum)
collections_and_for_each.description: Internal implementation of VB.Collection: Add, Remove, Count, Item, and the hidden _NewEnum (dispid -4) returning IEnumVARIANT for For Each loops.

references.notes: Using Collection, Key hashing, 1-based indexing
Weak references and Collections, avoiding circular leaks
Building custom strongly-typed collection classes, wrapping _NewEnum
IEnumVARIANT specification: Next, Skip, Reset, Clone

collections_and_for_each.compiler_relevance: Compile For Each var In col into: call col._NewEnum -> QueryInterface IEnumVARIANT -> call Next(1, var, fetched) -> loop.
collections_and_for_each.runtime_relevance: Implement Collection coclass with GUID {a4c4671c-499f-101b-bb78-00aa00383cbb} and exact dispids: Item(0), Add(1), Count(2), Remove(3), _NewEnum(-4).

usercontrols_and_ocx.title: ActiveX Controls (UserControl) & PropertyBag Persistence
usercontrols_and_ocx.description: UserControl architecture, AmbientProperties, ExtenderProperties, PropertyBag binary/text serialization, and Form designer integration.

The UserControl Object, lifecycle events
Extender and Ambient Objects
Properties, PropertyBag, ReadProperties / WriteProperties
Step-by-step UserControl development in VB6

usercontrols_and_ocx.compiler_relevance: Compile UserControl into an OCX / COM component exposing IOleObject, IOleControl, IViewObject, IProvideClassInfo.
usercontrols_and_ocx.ide_x64: Form Designer hosting UserControls, resolving AmbientProperties (UserMode, BackColor) and ExtenderProperties (Left, Top, Width, Height, Name).

Business base class, validation engine
Complete VideoObjects project, real enterprise domain model
VideoObjectsMTS: Transactional COM+ / MTS components
Multi-tier enterprise systems, MTS/COM+ architecture
